tracks.title: Lunch after class

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 授業のあとで、いっしょにお昼ごはんを食べませんか。
turns.english: Would you like to have lunch together after class?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいですね。駅の前のレストランはどうですか。
turns.english: Sounds good. How about the restaurant in front of the station?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 今日はあの店は休みですよ。

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: そうですか。じゃあ、学校のとなりのカフェにしましょう。
turns.english: I see. Then let's go with the café next to the school.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい、そこにしましょう。

comprehensionPrompts: What does the woman invite the man to do?
Why do they not choose the station restaurant?
Where do they finally decide to go?

tracks.title: A polite decline and a new plan

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 土曜日に公園で会いませんか。
turns.english: Would you like to meet at the park on Saturday?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: すみません。土曜日はちょっと。日曜日はどうですか。
turns.english: Sorry, Saturday is difficult. How about Sunday?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 日曜日なら大丈夫です。何時に会いましょうか。
turns.english: Sunday works for me. What time shall we meet?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: わかりました。日曜日の二時ですね。

comprehensionPrompts: Which day do they agree on?
What time do they agree to meet?
